selection_authority: Eight exact Wikimedia Commons files were selected by source metadata and source-only pixel audit before any PB18 OCR, ADE20K semantic, or portal-proposer call. Four frames contain an unambiguous target portal, two contain target identity but no portal, and two contain both the target building portal and a separately signed tenant portal as an instance-level ownership decoy. Every exact filename and every frozen English or Chinese entity name had zero hits in the PB1-PB17 active source files and local named-poi manifests.

freeze_rules.identity_profiles: Only the exact entity aliases above are admissible; generic agency logos, tenant names, filename misspellings, street names, and photographer metadata are excluded.
freeze_rules.portal_roles: Rows 1-4 contain target portals, rows 5-6 contain no visible portal, and rows 7-8 contain both a target portal and a separately signed tenant-portal decoy. The latter are portal-instance ownership controls, never whole-frame negatives.
freeze_rules.model_access: No OCR, ADE20K semantic model, portal proposer, or identity model may run before local integrity, human target-portal boxes, and human tenant-decoy boxes are frozen.

claim_boundary: Deliberately identity-opportunity-stratified, entity/file-disjoint public-image cohort. It can confirm conditional current-frame entity-proof-to-functional-portal binding and reject explicitly labeled tenant portals, not natural prevalence, legal/public access, traversability, active-view causality, metric guidance, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
